business_requirement: The normal A2 workflow has one consolidated human review at the end, after all permitted enrichment, evidence, confidence, conflict, quality and proposed-update processing is complete. Routine intermediate human approvals are prohibited.

test_phase_boundary.purpose: Verify each new stage before accepting the complete automated workflow.

normal_runtime_flow: automated gap planning and permitted research
automated canonical revision and consolidated review package
guarded HubSpot write when the exact reviewed patch, permissions and integration gates are active
no_second_human_review_required_when: the executed patch is byte-for-byte or semantically identical to the reviewed patch
the reviewer has HubSpot-write approval authority
workflow and list dependencies are verified
the guarded write succeeds and read-back reconciles
mandatory_exception_holds: proposed write differs from the reviewed patch

current_pilot.canonical_business_review: must occur once at the final consolidated Jonabell package

affected_artifacts_to_amend: Step 8 pilot runbook and acceptance tests
